page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of an opening). Running head at top centre, page number top right. Main text in a full-width block above a grid of monogram figures with captions (saints' names in small type between and under the figures). Below the figures: centred word FINIT. Lower right: catchword-like word KERO- at the foot. Faint show-through of the facing page's text in the lower half, not transcribed.

main_text.p: Litterae enim monogrammae scriptae nonnullis in locis inueniuntur, vbi pictura cum museo in pariete imaginis aut in velis, vel alicubi aliter facta fuerit, ibi eorum nomina cum congerie litterarum, vnum caracterem pictores facere soliti sunt, quod monogramma dicitur. quorum significatio subtus per pauca adnotata monstratur.

Monogram figures, each captioned with a saint's name in small type: Dominus; Sancta; Maria; Sanctus; Ioannes; Philippus; Thomas; Matthaeus; Petrus; Paulus; Andreas; Iacobus; Simon; Iudas; Iacobus; Matthias; Bartholomeus; Salomon; Repacificus (the last figure labelled "Re paci-" and "ficus" in the margin).

page.notes: Monogram figures are drawings, not transcribed as text; their captions are given above. Captions as printed are partly abbreviated and split by hyphens; the reading of the two last captions is uncertain. The lower half of the page shows bleed-through from the facing page and is omitted. The word at the foot right reads KERO- (hyphenated, continuing on the next page).
